name: Mint (Pudina)
description: Fast-growing aromatic herb, perfect for beginners. Thrives in small containers and grows back after cutting. One of India's most-used kitchen herbs.

growingSteps.title: Prepare Container
growingSteps.description: Add drainage holes. Fill with moist soil.
growingSteps.proTip: Make sure your pot has 4 to 6 small drainage holes at the bottom so water never collects inside.
growingSteps.commonMistake: Pressing the soil too hard! Keep the soil light and fluffy so young roots can breathe easily.

growingSteps.title: Plant Cuttings
growingSteps.description: Take 4-inch cuttings, remove lower leaves, push into soil.
growingSteps.proTip: Mist the soil gently with a spray bottle every morning. Never pour heavy water directly on tender sprouts.
growingSteps.commonMistake: Overwatering! If the top layer of soil is already wet, do not add more water.

growingSteps.title: First Harvest
growingSteps.description: Harvest top leaves once 6 inches tall.
growingSteps.proTip: Add 1 handful of fresh vermicompost around the stem every 2 weeks to feed growing leaves.
growingSteps.commonMistake: Leaving dead or yellow leaves on the plant. Snip them off immediately to save plant energy.
